## Describe the bug
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

## Area
- [ ] API (`api/` — Cloudflare Workers)
- [ ] Frontend (`frontend/` — Base44 site)
- [ ] Docs / other

## To reproduce
Steps or a request that triggers the bug. For the API, include the exact URL/curl:

```
curl "https://api.anatome.dev/generateImage?..."
```

## Expected behavior
What you expected to happen.

## Actual behavior
What actually happened (status code, response body, screenshot, console errors).

## Environment
- Endpoint / URL:
- Browser / client:
- Date & time (UTC):

## Additional context
Anything else that helps us reproduce it.
